'''Timfraku''' is the leader of the [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] village. He has three sons, [[Tamayu]], [[Tiadeche]], and [[Tinsay]], who you must bring back to the village during the [[Tai Bwo Wannai Trio]] [[quest]]. Unlike other villagers, he does not give you [[trading sticks]] if you have favour from [[Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup]]. He can be found up the ladder in the hut north-west of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]].
